description: This file defines the ElasticSearchEngine class, a PHP implementation of a search engine that uses Elasticsearch for performing real-time searches within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for constructing search parameters, executing searches, and parsing Elasticsearch results, and extends a base SearchEngine class. The class interacts with Elasticsearch via the Elasticsearch PHP client and handles search queries, including wildcards and specific module indexing.

classes.name: ElasticSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine class leveraging Elasticsearch to perform near real-time searches, extending the base SearchEngine class of SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ElasticSearchEngine with an Elasticsearch client instance, defaulting to a client builder if none provided.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search based on a SearchQuery object, executing Elasticsearch queries and returning populated SearchResults with timing and hit count.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and normalizes the SearchQuery by trimming and encoding conversion.

methods.name: createSearchParams
methods.description: Creates an array of Elasticsearch search parameters from a SearchQuery, applying wildcards as configured.

methods.name: runElasticSearch
methods.description: Executes a search request to Elasticsearch using the provided parameters.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Parses Elasticsearch hits into an array grouped by module name, including retrieving module metadata for result annotation.
